```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import os
import seaborn as sns
from seaborn import objects as so
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scvi
from scvi.model import SCANVI
import harmonypy as hm
import anndata
```

```{python}
# ============================================================
# 1. Load reference and select reference HVGs
# ============================================================

ref = sc.read("2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad")

sc.pl.umap(ref, color="labels")

sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(
    ref,
    n_top_genes=2000,
    batch_key="GEX_id",
    subset=True
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Load query and prepare it to match reference genes
# ============================================================

query = sc.read_h5ad("3_carpallcohort3_clustered.h5ad")

gene1 = np.asarray(
    query[:, "CAR_CD19_variable_region"].X.toarray()
).ravel()

gene2 = np.asarray(
    query[:, "CAR_CD22_variable_region"].X.toarray()
).ravel()

query = query[
    (gene1 > 0.5) | (gene2 > 0.5)
].copy()

query.obs["Timepoint_bin"] = query.obs["Timepoint"]



query = query[
    query.obs["Timepoint_bin"].isin(["d14", "d150", "Product"])
].copy()

query = query[:, ref.var_names].copy()


# ============================================================
# 3. Train SCVI on the reference
# ============================================================

scvi.model.SCVI.setup_anndata(
    ref,
    layer="counts"
)

model = scvi.model.SCVI(ref)

model.train()


# ============================================================
# 4. Train SCANVI using the reference labels
# ============================================================

scanvi_model = SCANVI.from_scvi_model(
    model,
    unlabeled_category="Unknown",
    labels_key="labels"
)

scanvi_model.train()


# ============================================================
# 5. Get SCANVI latent representation for reference
# ============================================================

SCANVI_LATENT_KEY = "X_scANVI"
SCANVI_PREDICTIONS_KEY = "predictions_scanvi"

ref.obsm[SCANVI_LATENT_KEY] = (
    scanvi_model.get_latent_representation()
)


# ============================================================
# 6. Map query onto the reference SCANVI model
# ============================================================

scvi.model.SCANVI.prepare_query_anndata(
    query,
    scanvi_model
)

scanvi_query = scvi.model.SCANVI.load_query_data(
    query,
    scanvi_model
)

scanvi_query.train(
    max_epochs=200
)


# ============================================================
# 7. Get query SCANVI latent representation + predictions
# ============================================================

query.obsm[SCANVI_LATENT_KEY] = (
    scanvi_query.get_latent_representation()
)

query.obs[SCANVI_PREDICTIONS_KEY] = (
    scanvi_query.predict()
)

prediction_probs = scanvi_query.predict(query, soft=True)

query.obs["scanvi_score"] = prediction_probs.max(axis=1)

ref.obs["scanvi_score"] = np.nan

# ============================================================
# 8. Check query predictions
# ============================================================

print(query.obs[SCANVI_PREDICTIONS_KEY].value_counts())


# ============================================================
# 9. Combine reference + query for a new joint embedding
# ============================================================

ref.obs[SCANVI_PREDICTIONS_KEY] = ref.obs["labels"]

full = anndata.concat(
    [ref, query],
    label="source",
    join="inner"
)

sc.pp.neighbors(
    full,
    use_rep=SCANVI_LATENT_KEY
)

sc.tl.umap(full)


# ============================================================
# 10. Plot the new joint embedding
# ============================================================

sc.pl.umap(
    full,
    color=[
        "source",
        "Timepoint_bin",
        "labels",
        "predictions_scanvi",
        "CD4", "CD8A"
    ],
    cmap="magma_r",
    frameon=False,
    ncols=2
)
```

# running scvi integration instead of reference mapping as there is clearly a batch effect
```{python}
ref = sc.read("2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad")

query = sc.read_h5ad("3_carpallcohort3_clustered.h5ad")

# again selectf or CAR+ cells
gene1 = np.asarray(
    query[:, "CAR_CD19_variable_region"].X.toarray()
).ravel()

gene2 = np.asarray(
    query[:, "CAR_CD22_variable_region"].X.toarray()
).ravel()

query = query[
    (gene1 > 0.5) | (gene2 > 0.5)
].copy()

#and remove the healthies (their timpeoint is NA)
query.obs["Timepoint_bin"] = query.obs["Timepoint"]

query = query[
    query.obs["Timepoint_bin"].isin(["d14", "d150", "Product"])
].copy()

query.obs["Source"] = query.obs["Timepoint_bin"].map({
    "d14": "PB",
    "d150": "PB",
    "Product": "Product"
})

common_genes = ref.var_names.intersection(query.var_names)

ref = ref[:, common_genes].copy()
query = query[:, common_genes].copy()
```

```{python}
full_int = anndata.concat(
    [ref, query],
    label="study",
    keys=["carpall_one", "carpall_three"],
    join="inner"
)
```

```{python}
print(full_int.obs["study"].value_counts())
```

```{python}
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(
    full_int,
    n_top_genes=2000,
    batch_key="study",
    subset=False
)
```

```{python}
full_int.write_h5ad("carpall_full_scvi_input.h5ad")
```

# this chunk ended up being run on the cluster
```{python}
scvi.model.SCVI.setup_anndata(
    full_int,
    layer="counts",
    batch_key="study"
)

model_int = scvi.model.SCVI(
    full_int
)

model_int.train()

full_int.obsm["X_scVI"] = (
    model_int.get_latent_representation()
)

sc.pp.neighbors(
    full_int,
    use_rep="X_scVI"
)

sc.tl.umap(full_int)

full_int.write_h5ad("carpall_full_scvi_corrected.h5ad")
```
